verdict.rationale: The evidence implies the error payload carries tags (search supports `-tag:wip` filters), arbitrary metadata (search by 'meta-data'), and user identity (the MCP server can 'see affected users'). The JS packages also mention 'event context' configuration options. None of this documents how a developer attaches that context in the SDK, and breadcrumbs are never mentioned. missing for 10: any evidence of breadcrumbs, explicit SDK docs for setting custom tags and user context per event, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
